artifacts.title: Illustrated furniture repair cards
artifacts.content: Make a small illustrated set of furniture repair cards from methods I use in my own workshop. Each card should show the tools and steps for one repair and fit on a single page.

artifacts.title: My workshop notebook
artifacts.content: The first booklet will collect my repair sketches and annotated notes about what worked. Keep the tone personal, like a record of fixes I have tried rather than a general repair manual.

artifacts.title: Testing one chair card
artifacts.content: Two neighbors tried the chair-repair card in a one-afternoon workshop and marked confusing steps. This was a prototype test; the booklet is still about repairs from my own workshop.

artifacts.title: A shared annotation pilot
artifacts.content: Made one wall sheet combining my chair diagram with a neighbor's handwritten note about a different joint. We are checking whether both notes fit on the page; nothing has been distributed as a shared guide.

artifacts.title: Proposal for a neighborhood repair guide
artifacts.content: Proposed collecting residents' repair methods and the stories behind them for a neighborhood guide. This is an editorial proposal; contributions have not been collected and no guide has been produced.
